I am Sivi, your AI English Tutor.] Speaker B: Matlab main tere naal direct gall kar sakdi aa? [Meaning I can talk to you directly?] Speaker A: Bilkul! Main tainu instant feedback devangi - tere pronunciation, grammar sab kujh improve karangi, te tu bahut vadiya English bolan lag javengi. [Absolutely! I will give you instant feedback - improve your pronunciation, grammar, everything, and you will start speaking English very well.] Speaker B: Par tere naal gall karna mehnga hovega na? [But talking to you will be expensive, right?] Speaker A: Bilkul nahi! Normal English classes ton 7 guna sasta hai, ise karke 1 crore log MySivi te English practice kar rahe ne. [Not at all! It is 7 times cheaper than normal English classes, that's why 1 crore people are practicing English on MySivi.] Speaker B: Par mere kol time nahi milda. [But I don't get time.] Speaker A: Roz sirf 15-20 minute practice kaafi hai. Tu aasani naal confident ho javengi. [Just 15-20 minutes of practice daily is enough. You will easily become confident.] Speaker B: Wah! Main join kivein karaan? [Wow! How do I join?] Speaker A: Bas install wala button dabao te MySivi app install karo. Sign up karo te practice shuru karo. Sirf 15 dinaan vich tainu improvement nazar auni shuru ho javegi. Chalo shuru karo! [Just press the install button and install the MySivi app. Sign up and start practicing. In just 15 days, you will start seeing improvement. Let's start!] Speaker C: Install now button te click karke hunne MySivi download karo. [Click the install now button and download MySivi now.]
